tool.name: mOTUs map_tax
tool.description: map reads to the mOTUs database for SNV calling
tool.command: @DATABASE_DIR_SETUP@ #if $inputs.reads_type.selector == 'single': #set $reads = 'input_reads.' + $inputs.reads_type.unpaired_reads.extension ln -s '$inputs.reads_type.unpaired_reads' '$reads' && #set $read_args = "-s '$reads'" #else: #set $reads_fwd = 'input_reads_fwd.' + $inputs.reads_type.forward_reads.extension #set $reads_rev = 'input_reads_rev.' + $inputs.reads_type.reverse_reads.extension ln -s '$inputs.reads_type.forward_reads' '$reads_fwd' && ln -s '$inputs.reads_type.reverse_reads' '$reads_rev' && #set $read_args = "-f '$reads_fwd' -r '$reads_rev'" #end if motus map_tax $read_args -db '$DATABASE_DIR' -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} -l '$algorithm_advanced_options.minimum_alignment_len' -o out.motus.bam && mv out.motus.bam '$bam_output'

param.name: unpaired_reads
param.label: Single-end reads
param.help: -s single read file(s), fastq(.gz)- or fasta(.gz)-formatted

param.name: forward_reads
param.label: Forward reads
param.help: -f reads in forward orientation, fastq(.gz)- or fasta(.gz)-formatted

param.name: reverse_reads
param.label: Reverse reads
param.help: -r reads in reverse orientation, fastq(.gz)- or fasta(.gz)-formatted

param.name: skip_pair_check
param.label: Skip pair check
param.help: Skip the check that read names of both mates match

param.name: minimum_alignment_len
param.label: Minimum alignment length (bp)
param.help: Alignments shorter than this are discarded. Default: 75 bp

tool.help:
# Map reads for mOTUs SNV calling
`motus map_tax` (which replaces the `map_snv` subcommand of mOTUs v3) maps short metagenomic reads against the mOTUs marker gene reference sequences using `bwa mem` and reports the alignments as a BAM file sorted by read name.
Only alignments with at least 97% identity and at least the specified minimum length are kept. For each read the best alignment is used; reads mapping to several marker genes are assigned proportionally to the abundance of the uniquely mapped reads.
-----
## Output
- **BAM file**: alignments of the reads against the mOTUs marker gene reference sequences, sorted by read name. It can be used for downstream single-nucleotide-variant (SNV) analyses, e.g. with `motus snv_call`.
